title: Rebuild expired draft app and add contact email

requirements.text: Rebuild and redeploy the existing draft application in its current state so it is accessible for review.

quotes: Rebuild my expired draft app and add my email address khutiaashim@gmail.com as my contact email

acceptanceCriteria: The application builds and deploys successfully without errors.
All existing sections (hero, content sections, documents, property details, header, footer) render correctly.

requirements.text: Add the contact email address khutiaashim@gmail.com to the website. Display it prominently as a clickable mailto link in an appropriate location such as the site footer or a dedicated contact section.

quotes: add my email address khutiaashim@gmail.com as my contact email

acceptanceCriteria: The email address khutiaashim@gmail.com is visible on the page.
The email is rendered as a clickable mailto:khutiaashim@gmail.com link.
The contact email is labeled clearly (e.g., 'Contact:' or 'Email:') so visitors understand its purpose.
The email link is styled consistently with the existing site theme.

constraints: Do not alter the existing content, layout, or visual theme beyond adding the contact email.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Adding a full contact form or any backend email-sending functionality.
Changing any property data, documents, or other existing site content.
